---
title: "🜔 Minor Mysteries"
---

Beyond the Bestiary lie sigils. They are not for the chasing.

They are bestowed upon those whose discipline reveals a deeper pattern — a kind of attention the codex did not name. Some are documented here. Others are not.

---

## 🜔 The Triple Offering

*+25 — bestowed upon those who lay three offerings before the Council in a single moon, beyond the weekly tribute.*

## 🜔 The Vigil

*+50 — for the apprentice whose tribute arrives unfailing across four consecutive moons.*

## 🜔 The Self-Hunt

*+30 — granted to those who hunt their own quarry, unbidden.*

## 🜔 The Forbidden Reading

*+30 — for the apprentice who consumes a grimoire outside the assigned canon, and returns with its essence.*

## 🜔 The First Light

*+10 — for the very first point of an apprenticeship. Once only.*

## 🜔 The Prophet

*+40 — for a vision spoken before the First Convergence that proved true. Once only.*

## 🜔 The Masters' Eye

*+75 — for the apprentice who finds an error in the masters' own work.*

---

There are others, undocumented. Discipline reveals them.
